fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (contradiction on testscripts-run-under-root): The leaf registers each script's $WORK folder as a project, but the scripts it must keep passing unedited (run-start, run-start-queue, daemon-repo-session, daemon-event-hook, ...) do `mkdir repo; cd repo; git init` and work in $WORK/repo. $WORK is not a git checkout, and $WORK/repo sits two levels under the root, so project-add-path refuses both (non-git folder; nested path). The repos those scripts use would not be registered projects, so runs-need-root and root-daemon-lock would exit 2 there. The leaf has to register the repo folder the script actually uses, or let the scripts change. The critic confirmed it: run-start, run-start-queue, daemon-settings, daemon-pause, daemon-event-hook, daemon-repo-session and stage-autonomy all do mkdir repo; cd repo; git init and work in $WORK/repo. testscripts-run-under-root registers $WORK (not a git checkout, and the repo sits a level below it), which project-add-path says is refused (non-git folder, nested deeper). The repos these scripts use would not be registered projects, so runs-need-root/root-daemon-lock would exit 2 and the 'unedited' acceptance cannot hold. How should it be settled?

Plan review round 3 left finding f2 (contradiction on testscripts-run-under-root): Its acceptance, and root-daemon-lock's, require daemon-repo-session.txtar to pass unedited. That script asserts the Rex session rhiza-repo, named after the checkout's folder. This change set retires daemon-repo-session and replaces it with root-daemon-rex-session, which names the session after the project's registered name (the $WORK folder, script-daemon-repo-session, under this Setup). The script tests a retired capability and would see a different session, so it cannot pass unedited. The critic confirmed it: daemon-repo-session.txtar asserts 'rex session new rhiza-repo' (folder-named). Change set 01M6RN3RCGAZ9RNTWTZPKFM61M retires 01M6FES3PKQCSNG9SEECK4G1R7 as superseded by root-daemon-rex-session (rhiza-<project>, the registered name). Yet testscripts-run-under-root and root-daemon-lock require that script to pass unedited, testing a retired capability. How should it be settled?
